subject: ZenHealth POC kickoff recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Zoe Patel <zoe.patel@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: ZenHealth POC - Recap & next steps

Hi Zoe - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap so we're aligned and can get the POC kicked off next week.

Key pain points you described:
- Current triage service: p95 latency 800-1200ms under typical load, causing degraded UX for mobile patients.
- Cost: inference spend is spiking on peak days; you want predictable unit economics.
- Data/privacy: PHI scope for triage data; audit logs and access controls are required.

Primary goals for the POC (what success looks like):
- Latency: p95 inference <= 200ms for the triage classifier under 50 req/s sustained.
- Quality: classification accuracy >= 92% on your internal triage test set.
- Cost: target average cost per 1M tokens <$120 (target to evaluate savings vs current infra).

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Kickoff/capacity: Redwood will provision a temporary Dedicated pool for ZenHealth to run load tests. (Rishi + Aditya to confirm capacity/profile).
2) Prompt set & evals: ZenHealth to share a ~500-example labeled prompt set (happy to accept CSV). We'll run reproducible evals and share results.
3) Access/setup: we'll need API keys + (optionally) VPC peering details for audit logging.
4) Timeline: aim to run initial evals and first-load test within 10 business days, then iterate.

Owners:
- ZenHealth PM: Zoe Patel (you) - provide prompt set & approvals
- Redwood PM: Marissa Cole - overall POC coordination
- Redwood SE: Rishi Malhotra - integration & load testing
- Redwood Infra: Aditya Rao - Dedicated pool config / capacity

I'll follow up with a formal kickoff recap (scope, metrics, owners, timeline, ask list) and attach a short SOW + prompt set template. Please confirm that the goals above look right, and share the prompt set when convenient.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: ZenHealth POC kickoff - scope, metrics, owners, timeline, access steps (recap)

Hi all - per our notes, here's the formal kickoff recap and the run-of-show for Friday 2027-09-17 (30-45m). Please review and flag anything missing.

Scope:
- Use case: Triage classifier for inbound patient messages (text). Redwood will serve model variants (base open model + quantized variants) via a short-lived Dedicated pool for load testing and eval.
- Data: ZenHealth will provide a de-identified (or PHI-handled per runbook) 500-example prompt set in CSV; Redwood will run evals and return metrics & traces.

Success metrics (primary):
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms at 50 req/s (sustained 10m window).
- Quality: overall accuracy >= 92%; precision/recall per class reported.
- Cost: baseline cost estimate + observed cost during load test; goal: demonstrable savings vs current infra.

Evaluation plan & prompt set:
- ZenHealth to provide prompt_set.csv (columns: id, prompt, expected_label, notes).
- Redwood will run deterministic evals across: 1) base model (float32), 2) 8-bit quantized variant, 3) 4-bit quantized variant (if supported).
- We'll produce a single eval report with per-variant metrics + latency distribution and example failure cases.

Owners & roles:
- ZenHealth: Zoe Patel (PM), Alex Chen (Eng)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (PM, POC owner), Rishi Malhotra (SE, integration & load tests), Aditya Rao (Infra, Dedicated pool), Neha Kapoor (Security lead - SOC2/KMSEvidence)

Timeline (proposed):
- 2027-09-15: ZenHealth shares prompt_set.csv + SOC2 evidence request (partial).
- 2027-09-17 (Fri): 30-45m kickoff + access provisioning verification.
- 2027-09-20: Redwood runs first eval and shares preliminary report.
- 2027-09-24: Load test with Dedicated pool + final report and recommendations.

Access & setup steps (action items):
1) ZenHealth: Share prompt_set.csv (encrypted link or SFTP) and SOC2 / contact for compliance questions.
2) Redwood: Create temporary API key scoped to ZenHealth POC (expires 2027-10-01); provide example client call and Postman collection.
3) Optional: If ZenHealth prefers VPC peering for logging, share VPC contact and CIDR; Redwood infra will accept request and share peering steps.

Attachments included: zenhealth-poc-sow.pdf (SOW), zenhealth-prompt-set-template.csv

Please confirm the timeline and that we have all required contacts. Zoe - if EOD 9/15 for prompt set still looks good, I'll get the API key provisioned on 9/16 so we can run the eval on 9/20.

Thanks - excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: zenhealth-prompt-set.csv (template stub); zenhealth-poc-sow.pdf (SOW stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ZenHealth POC - infra/config asks (please confirm)

Quick internal note following the kickoff recap sent to the customer. Rishi/Aditya - can you confirm the following by EOD today so I can update the ZenHealth timeline?

Infra/config asks:
- Provision temporary Dedicated pool: target 2x A100-equivalent for initial load tests (config: 50 req/s sustained, burst to 100 req/s).
- Model variants to stage: open-base-1.3 (float32), open-base-1.3-8bit, open-base-1.3-4bit.
- KV/prefix caching enabled for short-context prompts (typical prompt length ~120 tokens).
- Tracing & audit logs: enable request-level traces and secure S3 bucket for logs with 90-day retention (customer requests auditability).
- Provide a temporary API key with read/write to POC project; expiry: 2027-10-01.

Neha - I've flagged SOC2 request; can you prepare the evidence pack (SSO settings, KMS usage, retention policy) and a short runbook we can share with ZenHealth?

If anything here is unrealistic, call it out and I'll adjust the timeline.

Thanks - Marissa
